Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Nickeil Alexander-Walker?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker is 27 years old.

Where was Nickeil Alexander-Walker born?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker was born in Toronto, Ontario.

When was Nickeil Alexander-Walker born?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker was born on September 2, 1998.

How tall is Nickeil Alexander-Walker?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much does Nickeil Alexander-Walker weigh?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker weighs 205 lbs (92 kg).

Is Nickeil Alexander-Walker in the Hall of Fame?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Nickeil Alexander-Walker drafted?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker was drafted by Brooklyn Nets, 1st round (17th pick, 17th overall), 2019 NBA Draft.

What position does Nickeil Alexander-Walker play?

Shooting Guard.

What is Nickeil Alexander-Walker's net worth?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker has made at least $38,510,913 playing professional basketball.

How much does Nickeil Alexander-Walker make?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker made $15,161,800 in 2026.

How many rings does Nickeil Alexander-Walker have?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker has won 0 championships.

What is Nickeil Alexander-Walker's Instagram account?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker is on Instagram at nickeilaw.

What schools did Nickeil Alexander-Walker attend?

Nickeil Alexander-Walker attended Hamilton Heights Christian in Chattanooga, Tennessee and Virginia Tech.

What are Nickeil Alexander-Walker's nicknames?

Keil, NAW, Popsicle are nicknames for Nickeil Alexander-Walker.
